entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello Charlie. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm considering a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Sarah Bell, and the order number is VF-9021055.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered 18 days ago. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, it's just really **hard to use**. I've read the **user manual** cover to cover, but the app interface is so **confusing**. I just **expected more** functionality for the price.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up our policies to see what options we have.

Okay. I know I'm a couple of weeks past the delivery date, so if a full return isn't on the table, I'd be willing to discuss a partial credit or maybe a discount code for a future purchase. I like your brand, this one just isn't for me.
I appreciate the offer, Sarah, but that won't be necessary. I'm looking at our return policy right now, and you are well within the 90-day return period.

Yes, absolutely. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. Just pack the sensor back in its original box, put the label on, and you can drop it at any post office. You'll see a full refund processed 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
